props.name: groupSource
props.comment:
The top-level field whose value names a column; a drop writes the target
column's `id` to it.

props.name: columns
props.comment: The columns, in order. A record whose group value names none is not shown.

props.name: titleSource
props.comment: The field shown as the card title; the record representation when it is null or undefined.

props.name: descriptionSource
props.comment: The field shown as a second line when its value is not empty.

props.name: linkType
props.comment:
Where a card goes when nothing listens to `select-card`. `edit` by default,
`show` when the resource has no edit view. `false` leaves cards inert.

slots.name: card
slots.comment: Replaces the title and description inside a card.
